title: Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — Part-Time
description:
We are looking for an experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / ISA to join our growing real estate business in the United States.



This is not a beginner position. We are looking for someone who already has experience calling U.S. homeowners and is comfortable handling objections, building rapport, and setting qualified appointments.



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 4 hours per day

Hours: Approximately 1:00 PM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Starting Pay: $5/hour, paid weekly

Hours: 20 hours/week

Opportunity for performance bonuses



Your primary responsibility will be calling homeowners, primarily Expired Listings, FSBOs and other seller leads, and setting qualified listing appointments.



You will be responsible for making outbound calls, having genuine conversations with homeowners, following our scripts while still sounding natural, handling common seller objections, qualifying motivation and timeline, setting appointments, accurately updating the CRM, and following up with leads when appropriate.



To qualify, you should have previous U.S. real estate cold-calling experience. Experience calling Expireds and FSBOs is strongly preferred. Experience with Mojo Dialer or similar multi-line dialers is a major plus.



You must have strong spoken English, a professional and confident phone presence, reliable internet, a quiet working environment and the ability to handle rejection without becoming discouraged.



Compensation & Growth



Starting compensation is $5/hour, paid weekly, plus performance incentives.



There will be opportunities to earn additional bonuses based on qualified appointments and business generated from your calls. Strong performers will have opportunities for increased hours, increased base pay and larger performance bonuses.



This position starts with a 2-week paid trial period. We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team if performance is strong.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction explaining your real estate cold-calling experience.

2. How long you’ve been cold calling U.S. homeowners.

3. What types of leads you’ve called — Expired, FSBO, circle prospecting, etc.

4. What dialers and CRMs you’ve used.

5. Your average number of calls and appointments per day/week in your previous position.

6. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you would respond to this homeowner objection:



“I’m not interested. I’m going to relist with my previous agent.”



Applications without the voice recording will not be considered. text on whatapp

title: Fashion Designer & Tech Pack Specialist for Australian Maternity & Breastfeeding Brand
description:
# Fashion Designer & Tech Pack Specialist for Australian Maternity & Breastfeeding Brand



**Remote | Freelance / Ongoing Work**



Sōma Society is a new Australian maternity and breastfeeding fashion brand creating elevated clothing designed for pregnancy, breastfeeding and beyond.



Our philosophy is fashion first. We want to create beautiful, contemporary womenswear that women genuinely want to wear, with discreet pregnancy and breastfeeding functionality thoughtfully incorporated into the design.



**For the body that nurtures.**



We are looking for a talented **Fashion Designer / Technical Apparel Designer** to work with us on an ongoing basis developing collections, original garment designs, textile prints and detailed factory ready tech packs.



This is not simply a tech pack role.



We are looking for someone who can contribute creatively to the design process while also having the technical knowledge required to turn an idea into a garment that can actually be manufactured.



## Creative Direction, Research & Mood Boards



We want someone who can help us develop the creative direction for future Sōma Society collections.



Depending on the project, this may include:



• Creating collection and garment mood boards  

• Researching current and emerging fashion trends  

• Researching silhouettes, garment details and construction ideas  

• Developing colour palettes  

• Exploring fabric and textile directions  

• Researching trims, buttons, zippers and hardware  

• Gathering visual references and inspiration  

• Developing initial garment concepts from a creative brief  

• Suggesting discreet pregnancy and breastfeeding functionality  

• Helping ensure garments within a collection feel cohesive  

• Translating approved concepts into original Sōma Society designs



Mood boards should communicate a strong visual direction while allowing the final garments to remain original Sōma Society designs rather than copies of existing products.



## Garment Design



Our collections may include:



• Dresses  

• Tops and T shirts  

• Matching sets  

• Shorts and pants  

• Knitwear and sweaters  

• Maternity friendly pieces  

• Breastfeeding specific garments  

• Other contemporary womenswear



You should be comfortable designing garments incorporating more technical features such as:



• Discreet breastfeeding access  

• Concealed and invisible zippers  

• Shirring  

• Elasticated construction  

• Stretch fabrics  

• Pregnancy friendly silhouettes  

• Contrast panels  

• Piping  

• Custom trims  

• Buttons and hardware  

• Double lining  

• Internal nursing functionality  

• Strategic elastic placement  

• Natural and organic fabrics



A strong understanding of **garment construction** is essential.



We particularly value someone who can look at a fashion concept and work out how breastfeeding access or pregnancy functionality can be incorporated without compromising the appearance of the garment.



## Tech Pack Development



You must be experienced in producing **detailed, accurate and factory ready tech packs**.



Depending on the garment, tech packs should include:



• Professional front and back technical flats  

• Detailed construction drawings  

• Close up drawings of important features  

• Full Bill of Materials (BOM)  

• Fabric specifications  

• Fabric composition  

• Fabric weight/GSM where applicable  

• Trims and hardware specifications  

• Zipper type, length and placement  

• Elastic specifications  

• Stitching and seam construction  

• Labels and branding placement  

• Colourways and colour references  

• Points of Measure (POM)  

• Accurate garment measurements  

• Size charts  

• Size grading  

• Measurement tolerances  

• Construction notes  

• Print and pattern specifications where applicable  

• Packaging or labelling specifications where required



Our manufacturers should be able to receive the tech pack and clearly understand **exactly how the garment is intended to be made** with minimal ambiguity.



Accuracy is extremely important.



## Textile & Print Design



We also want someone capable of creating original textile artwork and production ready print files.



This may include:



• Seamless repeat patterns  

• Custom repeatable prints  

• Placement prints  

• Border prints  

• Stripes and other repeating designs  

• Print scale and positioning specifications  

• Multiple colourways  

• Production ready artwork for fabric printing



You should understand the difference between repeat, engineered and placement prints and know how to communicate scale, positioning and colour requirements to textile and garment manufacturers.



## Textile, Fabric & Trim Research



Sōma Society has a strong preference for **natural fibres wherever practical**.



This includes materials such as organic cotton, cotton, linen, wool and other suitable natural fibres.



You may assist us with researching and sourcing:



• Fabrics suitable for specific garment designs  

• Organic and certified fabrics  

• Fabric composition and GSM  

• Stretch requirements  

• Shirring compatible fabrics  

• Linings  

• Elastic  

• Piping  

• Concealed and invisible zippers  

• Buttons  

• Labels  

• Custom trims  

• Hardware  

• Textile printing options



We are looking for someone who can consider both the appearance **and technical suitability** of a textile.



For example, if a particular design requires stretch, shirring, structure, drape or recovery, you should be able to help identify appropriate fabric specifications.



Experience communicating with fabric suppliers, textile mills or garment manufacturers would be highly regarded.



## Working With Manufacturers



We already work directly with overseas garment manufacturers.



Ideally, you will be comfortable assisting throughout the development process, including:



**Concept → Mood Board → Design → Tech Pack → Sampling → Fit Review → Revisions → Production**



This may involve reviewing manufacturer questions, updating specifications after sampling and helping solve construction issues that arise during development.



## Skills We're Looking For



You should have:



• Professional fashion or technical apparel design experience  

• Strong Adobe Illustrator skills  

• Excellent technical drawing skills  

• Strong knowledge of garment construction  

• Experience creating complete factory ready tech packs  

• Experience creating BOMs and POM/specification sheets  

• Knowledge of garment measurements and size grading  

• Experience specifying fabrics, trims, zippers, elastic and hardware  

• Ability to develop original garments from a creative brief  

• Ability to create mood boards and collection concepts  

• Ability to create seamless repeat and placement prints  

• Understanding of textile properties and garment manufacturing  

• Strong attention to detail  

• Good written English  

• Ability to work collaboratively through sampling and revisions



Experience in **womenswear, maternity, breastfeeding, resort wear or contemporary fashion** would be particularly valuable.



## Budget & Rates



We are looking for an ongoing designer rather than someone for a single project. We expect to develop multiple garments and collections over time.



Our approximate target budgets are:



**Original garment design + complete factory ready tech pack**  

Approximately **US$50–100 per style**, depending on complexity.



**Mood board / initial collection design direction**  

Approximately **US$5–15**



**Simple seamless repeat pattern**  

Approximately **US$10–20**



**Detailed placement print / textile artwork**  

Approximately **US$20–40**



**Textile, fabric and trim research/sourcing**  

Can be quoted hourly or incorporated into the relevant design project.



These are guides rather than strict limits. More complicated garments or projects can be discussed individually.



We are interested in both **hourly and fixed project pricing**.



## What to Include in Your Application



Please focus on showing us your actual work rather than sending a long cover letter.



### 1. Tech Pack Portfolio



Please provide examples of **complete tech packs you have personally created**.



We specifically want to see examples containing:



• Technical flats  

• BOM  

• POM and measurement specifications  

• Size grading  

• Construction details  

• Fabric and trim specifications



Please do not submit only fashion illustrations.



### 2. Fashion Design Portfolio



Please show examples of original garments you have personally designed.



Where possible, we would particularly like to see:



**Mood Board → Original Design → Tech Pack → Finished Manufactured Garment**



### 3. Mood Boards



Please provide examples of fashion or collection mood boards you have personally created.



We would like to see how you take inspiration and develop it into a cohesive original design direction.



### 4. Textile & Print Design



Please provide examples of any:



• Seamless repeat patterns  

• Placement prints  

• Border prints  

• Custom textile designs



that you have personally created.



### 5. Textile & Sourcing Experience



Please briefly explain any experience you have researching or sourcing fabrics, trims, zippers, elastic, hardware or other garment components.



### 6. Software



Please tell us which software you use for:



• Fashion design  

• Technical drawings  

• Tech packs  

• Mood boards  

• Textile and print design  

• Measurement specifications and grading



### 7. Your Rates & Typical Time Required



Please provide both your **hourly rate and typical fixed project rates**.



Please complete the following:



**Hourly rate:** US$___ / hour



**Typical time required for one complete garment design + tech pack:** ___ hours / days



**Fixed price for one complete garment design + tech pack:** US$___



**Fixed price for a mood board / collection design direction:** US$___



**Fixed price for a simple seamless repeat pattern:** US$___



**Fixed price for a placement print:** US$___



**Rate for textile and trim sourcing/research:** US$___



Please also tell us how many rounds of revisions are included in your fixed pricing.



### 8. Manufacturer Experience



Please briefly describe your experience working directly with garment manufacturers and making changes to designs or tech packs during sampling.



If you have experience working with manufacturers in China or other international manufacturing markets, please let us know.



## About the Relationship



We are looking for someone we can build a **long term working relationship with** as Sōma Society grows.



The right person may become involved across future collections from the earliest creative concepts and mood boards through to technical development, sampling and production.



We value creativity, technical accuracy, reliability and someone who genuinely enjoys developing beautiful womenswear.



Please begin your application with **“Sōma Society”** so we know you have read the complete listing.

title: Freelance Video Editor — Talking-Head Content (Project-Based)
description:
Freelance Video Editor for Marketing Agency Content — Project-Based



Hi! I’m David, owner of a marketing agency specializing in website design and SEO.



I’m preparing to create content to promote my agency before launching paid ads. My goal is to produce polished, professional videos that build trust and attract potential clients. I’m building a shortlist of reliable freelance editors to contact when projects are ready.



This is a paid, project-based opportunity, not a full-time position. Since I’m just starting with content creation, I can’t guarantee a start date or regular workload yet. If the collaboration goes well and I produce content more frequently, I’d love to work with the same editor regularly.



I have some editing experience, but I’m looking for a dedicated editor who can bring stronger storytelling, pacing, and visual polish while allowing me to focus on recording and growing my agency.



What you’ll edit



Scripted talking-head videos about marketing, website design, and SEO, with an expected finished length of 1–3 minutes. I’ll provide the script, recorded footage, and direction.



Editing will include:



- Clean cuts and engaging pacing.

- Relevant B-roll, captions, text highlights, and graphics.

- Music, sound effects, and thoughtful transitions.

- Audio cleanup, color correction, and exports for social media.



I like Iman Gadzhi’s editing style as creative inspiration, and I understand that this level of production involves significant time, skill, and often advanced motion graphics work in software like After Effects. I’m open to a simpler approach, and I’d love to see your own style and what you can realistically deliver. I’ll share a sample script and specific references with shortlisted applicants so we can agree on the scope, pricing, and expectations.



Software and project delivery



Please use Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Deliverables should include the finished video plus the organized, editable project and supporting media so we can collaborate smoothly and I can make adjustments when needed.



I currently have an Artlist subscription to help source B-roll, music, and sound effects, but you’re welcome to use your own properly licensed resources if you prefer.



Please let me know in advance if you have any recording recommendations or need specific materials to make the editing process smoother. Your quoted rate should include your usual software and tools. Any additional project expenses should be discussed and approved before purchase.



To apply, please include:



1. Links to 2–3 videos you’ve edited, ideally talking-head or business content. If any were a team effort, briefly mention which parts you handled. Include the links directly in your application and make sure they open without requesting access.

2. Your per-video and/or hourly rate.

3. Your typical turnaround time and availability for occasional projects.

4. Your editing software/version, any required paid plugins or features, and confirmation that you can deliver editable projects.



Optional bonus: Graphic design



If you also create social media posts or other online graphics, feel free to share examples and rates. This could lead to additional work, but it’s completely optional and not required for the editing role.



As someone who also edits videos, I appreciate the time, effort, and skill behind good work. I value quality, communication, and reliability, and I want to build a lasting working relationship. As I start creating content, I’ll commission as much work as my budget allows while paying fairly for each project.



Looking forward to seeing your work!

title: Automation Specialist (Go high level, Zapier, Booking koala) Help Me Build a Self-Running Cleaning Business
description:
Hi everyone! I run a cleaning business and I'm looking for a person or agency who can quickly build automations I can use in my business every day. I'd like daily check-ins: a morning update on what's planned for the day, progress updates during the day, and an end-of-day summary of what was finished and what's planned for the next work period.



My current setup:



Website with a custom-coded intake form

BookingKoala for bookings

GoHighLevel (GHL), which already runs my hiring funnel automations and a few ai responses to messages. 



What I'd love to automate:



Client intake: Connect my website's intake form, including client photos of their space, to GHL so every lead is captured and followed up automatically.

Self-booking: Clients pick their own date and time without needing to message me.

Payments: Clients save a card and pay for their cleaning online. My pricing is hourly for first-time cleanings and a flat rate for recurring clients, so the system needs to handle both.

Cleaner confirmations: Cleaners get confirmation texts, and reminders go out at more than one point before each job.

Smart auto-replies: Texts that understand common replies like "confirm," "reschedule," or "cancel" and respond the right way.

Escalation: If something goes wrong (a cleaner doesn't confirm, a client has an issue, or a payment fails), the system handles it or flags it to the right person automatically.



The goal: A business that gets booked, confirmed, and escalated without me checking on it. I just want to be able to watch what's happening.



How we'll work together:



- Paid one-week trial to start. If it's a great fit, we'll move to an ongoing monthly arrangement.

- Full time I care about speed and result expectations, not hours logged even tho there will be clock in communication and updates

- Daily check-ins in the morning, during the day, and at the end of the day.



To apply, please send:



- Examples of service businesses you've automated. Cleaning, home services, salons, or similar are a big plus. 

Screenshots, links, or a short walkthrough of what you built are all welcome.

- Your rate for the one-week trial and for ongoing monthly work.

- Your experience with GoHighLevel and BookingKoala, and how you'd connect BookingKoala to my existing GHL setup.

We are looking for a highly organized Executive Virtual Assistant to support two founders across executive administration, event operations, hiring coordination, and growth follow-up.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for tasks. You will take ownership of the details that allow founders to stay focused on client strategy, relationships, delivery, and growth. You will manage the moving pieces: inboxes, calendars, event checklists, follow-ups, candidate scheduling, and project tracking.



You do not need to know our business or tools on day one; we will teach you our processes. What we cannot teach quickly is excellent judgment, calm follow-through, and the habit of seeing a loose end through to resolution.



Responsibilities:



1. Executive support and communication



Organize and triage founder inboxes; flag urgent messages, draft straightforward replies where appropriate, and make sure important commitments receive a follow-up.



Manage calendars, meeting preparation, scheduling changes, reminders, and light travel or event logistics.



Maintain a daily and weekly priorities view across meetings,
, Slack, and Notion so key items do not disappear in the noise.



Create simple meeting notes, action lists, and follow-up summaries; chase owners and close loops without repeated prompting.



2. Event operations



Coordinate the operational side of virtual and in-person events, workshops, community sessions, and industry gatherings.



Build and run event checklists, timelines, agendas, attendee communications, speaker or vendor coordination, and logistics.



Capture leads, conversations, and action items from each event; ensure thank-yous, follow-ups, meeting scheduling, and CRM/Notion updates happen promptly.



Support pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up so events become a repeatable pipeline engine, not a pile of business cards and good intentions.



3. Project tracking and operations



Keep Notion current with projects, priorities, owners, deadlines, and next steps.



Coordinate across Slack, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and internal tools to keep work visible and moving.



Identify recurring administrative bottlenecks and create practical systems to remove them.



4. Social media and growth support



Support light social-media execution around events, company activity, and founder content: prepare approved drafts, coordinate assets, schedule posts, and monitor basic engagement.



Keep contacts, lead data, follow-up lists, and event notes clean and organized.



Assist with basic SDR-style administration, including research support, lead-list cleanup, follow-up tracking, and handoff of warm prospects.



5. Hiring coordination



Keep active hiring processes moving: monitor applicant communications, coordinate 15-minute screening calls, manage reschedules, and maintain candidate records.



Work alongside existing screening workflows and automation; step in when a person needs a clear response, coordinated schedule, or thoughtful follow-up.



6. Owns the follow-through



You will be the operational backstop for the founders. The standard is simple: important messages, commitments, applicants, leads, and event tasks should not die quietly in an inbox or task list.



What we need from you:



3+ years of experience as an executive assistant, virtual assistant, operations coordinator, project coordinator, or similar high-accountability role.

Experience supporting a founder, executive, agency leader, community leader, or fast-moving small business.

Excellent written and spoken English, with a professional, calm, and concise communication style.

Proven event, workshop, community, or marketing coordination experience is strongly preferred.

Exceptional organization and follow-through. You can convert an ambiguous request into a clear action plan.

Strong working knowledge of Notion, Google Workspace, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, and calendar tools.

Comfortable working across several priorities without losing detail or requiring constant direction.

Experience with CRM workflows, lead follow-up, scheduling tools, recruiting coordination, basic SDR support, or social-media operations is a strong advantage.

Sound judgment about urgency and confidentiality. You will be handling founder communications, candidate information, and client-related activity.

Work style, hours and expectations:



Requested scheduled working hours with meaningful overlap in Pacific Time. The founders are based in the United States.

Part-time to start, with the potential to grow into a larger ongoing role for the right person.

Independent contractor: it is fine to have other clients as long as the work here gets done well, on time, and with consistent availability.

Equipment: your own computer and a stable internet connection.

Attention to detail: when you apply, include the phrase “Close the loop” somewhere in your application so we know you read the whole description.

Proof of work:



We will ask every serious applicant for proof that they have worked in a role requiring real ownership and follow-through. Two options:



Written: describe one executive, operations, event, or project-coordination challenge you owned. Explain the situation, the moving pieces, the system you used, how you kept people accountable, and the outcome. Screenshots or examples are welcome with confidential details blurred.

Video (preferred): a 2 to 3 minute Loom recording walking us through a Notion workspace, event plan, project tracker, or operating system you built or ran. Talk us through how you prioritize, track follow-ups, and prevent things from falling through the cracks.

How to apply:



Interested candidates should submit the following in our Google form: 



A few rules for this application:



Please do not apply if you prefer a narrow, task-by-task role. We need someone comfortable taking responsibility for a moving set of priorities.

Read the entire job description and fill out the application thoroughly.

Do not send only links to a portfolio, CV, or LinkedIn. Tell us something specific about how you organize work, manage urgency, and keep commitments from being dropped. Low-effort applications will be skipped.

Please include:



Resume

A short cover note

Your proof of work (written or video, see above)

The tools you have used and rough time on each: Notion, Google Workspace, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, calendar/scheduling tools, CRM tools, event platforms, social-media scheduling tools, and recruiting tools

title: Content & Community Coordinator
description:
Content & Community Coordinator (Contract, Remote)



About the company



We are a fast-growing AI consultancy that helps organisations turn AI tools into real business outcomes. We work hands-on with teams to identify high-value workflows, train and enable teams, and build practical AI solutions. Our work sits at the intersection of AI strategy, implementation, community, and client delivery.



The founders are active in the AI ecosystem: sharing ideas publicly, hosting workshops and community sessions, and building an audience around practical AI. We need someone who can help turn that presence into consistent, high-quality content and community engagement.



The role



Botified is looking for a creative, reliable, and engaging Content & Community Coordinator to strengthen how we show up externally.



This is not a traditional marketing role where you own strategy alone. Our team stays closely involved in messaging and direction. You’ll take that direction, add creativity and personality, and help us execute consistently across LinkedIn, blog, newsletter, and community touchpoints.



You’ll work closely with a small, hands-on team to keep our external presence fresh, active, and engaging.



Responsibilities



1. Content drafting and publishing

Draft, edit, and publish LinkedIn content. Maintain and publish blog content. Help manage our Substack newsletter. Repurpose ideas and content across channels so strong material gets more than one life.



2. Content operations

Keep the content calendar organized and moving. Turn direction into scheduled, publishable work without dropping follow-through. Track what’s drafted, approved, published, and due next.



3. Workshops and community

Help coordinate and support roughly one workshop or webinar per month. Potentially help host or facilitate those sessions. Support community engagement and other outward-facing initiatives.



4. Creative contribution

Bring practical ideas for how Botified can better connect with its audience. Suggest formats, angles, and light campaigns that fit a founder-led AI consultancy.



What we need from you



Excellent English writing and communication skills, with a strong, natural, engaging writing voice.

Comfortable with LinkedIn, blogs, newsletters, and content publishing.

Genuine excitement and curiosity around AI.

Creative, organized, and dependable; able to move quickly from direction to execution.

Comfortable working closely with a small, hands-on team.

Friendly, engaging personality and comfortable being somewhat outward-facing.

Nice to have: Substack or newsletter experience; content-calendar ownership; hosting webinars/workshops; familiarity with Claude, ChatGPT, Notion, or similar tools.



Work style, hours and expectations



About 40 hours per week.

Compensation: $1,200 USD per month.

Part-time / independent contractor; other clients are fine as long as this work is done well, on time, and with consistent availability.

Meaningful overlap with Pacific Time preferred; founders are based in the United States.

Equipment: your own computer and a stable internet connection.

Attention to detail: when you apply, include the phrase “Close the loop” somewhere in your application so we know you read the whole description.



Proof of work



We will ask every serious applicant for proof of content craft and follow-through. Two options:

Written: share 1–2 writing samples (LinkedIn posts, newsletter issues, or blog posts) you wrote, plus a short note on your process from brief to publish.

Video (preferred): a 2–3 minute Loom walking through a content calendar, publishing workflow, or community/content system you’ve run.



How to apply



Interested candidates should submit the following in our Google form: 



A few rules for this application



Read the entire job description and fill out the application thoroughly.

Do not send only links to a portfolio, CV, or LinkedIn. Show us your voice and how you ship content. Low-effort applications will be skipped.



Please include



Resume

Your proof of work (written or video)

title: Video Editor (Social · Podcast · Film · Stills)
description:
Video Editor (Social · Podcast · Film · Stills)

Full-time independent contractor · Remote (Philippines) · Monthly fee · Reports to the CMO

L O C A T I O N: Remote — must be based in the Philippines

E N G A G E M E N T T Y P E: Full-time independent contractor, 40 hours/week

C O M P E N S A T I O N: PHP 55,000 – 85,000 monthly fee, based on experience; no equity

S C H E D U L E: Core hours 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT (≈5 hrs overlap with the European workday); flexible outside core hours

R E P O R T S T O: Katja Wallisch, Fractional CMO — working day to day with the brand, sanctuary, and founding team

S T A R T D A T E: October – November 2026



About Acraya



Acraya builds sanctuaries for spiritual wanderers: a global network of dark retreat sanctuaries where guests spend several days in complete, sustained darkness. It is a contemplative practice with a thousand-year lineage in Tibetan Bön and Dzogchen, Taoist, and ceremonial traditions, delivered with modern design, safety, and care. Our first sanctuary, in the Diamante Valley of Costa Rica, is open and welcoming guests. Bali opens in 2027, Nepal is in development at a living Bön monastery, and we are bringing on partner properties around the world.



Content is how we reach the people who matter most to us: serious practitioners and wellness travelers, most of whom don’t

yet know this practice exists in a form this considered; teachers, facilitators, and creators who can carry the story to their own

communities; and wellness properties that want to host a sanctuary of their own. We are on podcasts, hosting teachers and

creators at our sanctuaries, and producing film in Costa Rica, Bali, and Nepal. You will be the person who turns all of that

footage into finished work.





The role



You will be Acraya’s first dedicated editor and will own the post-production pipeline end to end: short-form social video,

podcast and interview content (full episodes and clips), longer-form brand and sanctuary film, and still image editing for

social, web, and partner materials. You’ll work from a clear brand system (typography, palette, motion language, and

templates) and from raw footage delivered by our team, contract shooters, and creator partners at our sanctuaries.

There is one creative problem at the heart of this job: a dark retreat can’t be filmed. The experience happens where no camera can see. Our story is told through place, light, sound, silence, and the words of people who have just come out of the dark. If that problem excites you, keep reading.

This is a hands-on, high-volume editing seat, not a strategy role. We are looking for someone who is fast, has refined taste, can hold a luxury aesthetic without tipping into clinical or crunchy, and can run a repeatable weekly production calendar with

minimal supervision.



What you’ll do



S O C I A L M E D I A V I D E O ( ≈ 4 0 % )

• Cut 8–12 short-form vertical videos per week (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from podcast appearances,

guest and facilitator interviews, sanctuary footage, and creator content.

• Add on-brand captions, hooks, text overlays, b-roll, and restrained motion graphics; format for each platform’s specs and

safe zones.

• Turn around same-day edits when a timely moment calls for it.



P O D C A S T S & C O N V E R S A T I O N S ( ≈ 2 5 % )

• Edit founder podcast appearances, conversations with teachers and facilitators, and guest interviews: sync cameras, clean

and level audio, remove dead air without losing the natural pauses, and add lower-thirds, chapter markers, and end cards.

• Produce a clip package for each conversation (6–10 clips), plus audiograms, YouTube thumbnails, and show-notes-ready

timestamps.

• Deliver platform-ready exports for YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and social.



L O N G - F O R M & S A N C T U A R Y F I L M ( ≈ 2 0 % )

• Edit brand films, sanctuary films for Costa Rica, Bali, and Nepal, guest stories, explainers on the practice and its lineage,

and partner-property presentations.

• Shape sound as carefully as picture (room tone, nature, breath, silence) to evoke an experience that happens without sight.

• Build and maintain reusable motion templates (intros, lower-thirds, transitions, the animated orb and wordmark) in After

Effects or Premiere.



S T I L L I M A G E E D I T I N G & G R A P H I C S ( ≈ 1 5 % )

• Retouch and grade photography of sanctuaries, landscapes, and people for social, web, print, and partner decks; build

carousels, quote cards, thumbnails, and story graphics from brand templates.

• Resize and adapt assets across formats and channels; keep the shared asset library organized and named consistently.

A C R O S S E V E R Y T H I N G

• Own the weekly post-production calendar and hit delivery deadlines without being chased.

ACRAYA · SANCTUARIES FOR SPIRITUAL WANDERERS · ACRAYA.GLOBAL · 2

• Apply the Acraya brand system rigorously: Cormorant and EB Garamond typography, the near-black and warm-gold

palette, the luminous orb motif, unhurried motion, and a quiet, assured tone.

• Route every piece featuring guests, facilitators, sacred sites, or statements about the practice through our review process

before it ships (see below).

• Track what performs and bring ideas back to the team about pacing, hooks, and formats.

What we’re looking for



R E Q U I R E D

• 3+ years of professional video editing, including at least one year producing short-form social content at volume for a

brand, agency, or creator.

• Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve; strong in After Effects for motion graphics and titles; fluent in

CapCut for quick-turn vertical work.

• Confident audio editing and mixing (Adobe Audition, Descript, or Resolve Fairlight), and an ear for silence. Podcast

experience is a strong plus.

• Strong color grading, especially of low-light, dusk, and night footage, where noise and muddy blacks are the enemy of a

premium image.

• Solid Photoshop and Lightroom skills for retouching and color; comfortable in Canva and Figma for template-based

graphics.

• Excellent written and spoken English; you can read a transcript and find the best 45 seconds, and you can write a caption

that sounds like a person, not a brochure.

• A portfolio that shows range: something fast and punchy, something slow and atmospheric, and something clean and

informational.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a capable editing machine, and a quiet place to work.

• Comfort with intimate, spiritual, and sometimes emotional material. People will be describing some of the most

profound experiences of their lives, and we treat that with respect.



N I C E T O H A V E

• Experience with luxury hospitality, travel, wellness, or contemplative brands.

• A meditation or contemplative practice of your own, or a genuine curiosity about one.

• Sound design for ambient or immersive pieces.

• Thumbnail design and YouTube packaging instincts.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools (auto-captioning, transcript-based cutting, upscaling, denoising) and a view on

where they help and where they don’t.

Working with sacred and sensitive material

Acraya’s brand rests on three pillars (safety, authenticity, and luxury), and our content is held to that standard. Three things

every editor here needs to internalize:

• Guest privacy. Discretion is part of what our guests come for. Nothing featuring a real guest is published without a

signed release on file, and we never include names, faces, or personal details beyond what has been consented to. When in

doubt, ask.

ACRAYA · SANCTUARIES FOR SPIRITUAL WANDERERS · ACRAYA.GLOBAL · 3

• Honest representation. A dark retreat is a contemplative practice, not a medical treatment. We let guests describe what

they experienced in their own words, and we never promise outcomes, imply health or therapeutic benefits, or edit in a

way that changes the meaning of what a guest, teacher, or facilitator said. Safety is always shown accurately.

• Respect for lineage. This practice comes from living traditions. Monastic communities, teachers, ceremonies, and sacred

objects are filmed and published only with permission, and never used as decoration.

We’ll train you on all of this. We just need you to care about it.

Compensation & engagement terms



M O N T H L Y  F E E

PHP 55,000 – 85,000, invoiced and paid monthly, set by

experience and portfolio



E N G A G E M E N T

S O F T W A R E

Adobe Creative Cloud and Descript licenses provided; you

supply your own editing hardware



T I M E O F F

Flexible scheduling around Philippine public holidays; planned time off agreed in advance with your manager



G R O W T H

First editing hire — path to Lead Editor as the content team

and sanctuary network grow; 90-day check-in and annual fee review



How to apply

 with the subject line “Video Editor — [Your Name]”:

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid, two-hour editing test using footage from our Costa Rica sanctuary.

The brief: make the viewer feel the darkness without ever showing it. That is followed by a video interview with our CMO

and CEO.



Our commitment

Acraya welcomes applicants of every background, tradition, and path, including none. We run a flexible, deadline-

based team across time zones that respects your time outside of core hours. We read everything, and we will respond

to everyone who sends all three items above.

title: WordPress Developer Wanted – Australian Solar, Battery & EV Charging Website
description:
I’m looking for an experienced WordPress developer to build a professional website for my Australian electrical business, Solar, Storage & Charge.



We specialise in residential solar, battery storage, EV charging and general electrical work in Melbourne.



I have already prepared a working draft website. The overall layout, page structure and most written content are substantially complete. This will be provided as the reference for the WordPress build.



The logo is currently being finalised, and some website content and design updates are still required. Final branding will be supplied, with the remaining changes agreed as part of the project.



The work will include:

- Building the complete website in WordPress, following the supplied draft’s layout, styling and content.

- Creating the service, product, project, advice, about and contact pages shown in the draft.

- Making the website work well on mobile, tablet and desktop.

- Incorporating the final logo, brand colours, supplied installation photos and product images.

- Setting up and testing enquiry forms, including spam protection and
 delivery.

- Making it straightforward for me to update text, photos, projects and articles.

- Launching the completed website on my chosen hosting and providing a short handover or video walkthrough.



We will provide a page-by-page SEO brief covering page titles, meta descriptions, H1/H2 headings, preferred URLs and internal linking requirements. You will be responsible for implementing these correctly in WordPress and completing the technical SEO setup, including the XML sitemap, appropriate structured data, image optimisation and indexing settings.



Website speed is important. Please optimise and test loading speed on mobile and desktop using Google PageSpeed Insights. Provide results for the homepage and representative service, product and project pages before handover, and address any significant performance issues. Testing should use the completed website with its final images, forms and plugins on the intended hosting.



I’m looking for someone with a strong eye for layout, spacing and typography, as well as solid WordPress skills. Attention to detail, clear communication and reliable delivery are important.



Please recommend the theme or page builder you would use and explain any ongoing costs. I will require full administrator access and ownership of the completed website, with any paid themes, plugins and licence arrangements clearly disclosed.



I would also like to know the approximate cost to add a custom interactive illustration on the homepage, showing solar generation, flowing to battery, battery discharging energy at night charging EV etc. An original design suited to Solar, Storage & Charge. Selecting a stage should highlight it and display a short explanation, with subtle transitions. It must work with a mouse on desktop and by tapping on mobile. The section should remain lightweight, accessible and easy to update, with the explanatory content built as website text. If it goes ahead, I can provide the wording and agree on the final design before development. Please include this feature in your quote as a separate cost and, if available, share a live example of similar interactive work you have built.



This is a fixed-price freelance project, with potential for ongoing paid maintenance and future updates.



To apply, please send:

- Three relevant live WordPress websites you have built, explaining your role in each.

- Your recommended approach, including the theme or page builder.

- An indicative project price in USD.

- Your availability, estimated completion time and what you need from me to begin.

- What your quote includes for revisions, launch support and fixing issues after handover.

- Any separate hosting, plugin, licence or maintenance costs.

- An example of website speed results you have achieved on a previous project, if available.



The draft website is private. Please include an
 address for viewer access so you can review the full website before providing your final quote. Your final quote should confirm the pages and functionality included.



Please begin your application with “SSC Website” so I know you have read the brief.

title: Etsy Growth & Store Manager – Digital Products
description:
Part-time | Up to 20 hours per week | US$8–10/hour + performance bonuses



I’m looking for an experienced, commercially minded Etsy Growth & Store Manager to help grow an established digital-products store focused on Excel and Google Sheets templates.



This is not a traditional VA role.



I’m looking for someone who can take ownership of growth, identify what is and is not working, make commercially sensible decisions, and action many of those changes directly across the products, listings and store.



The store currently has products, sales history and an existing catalogue, but growth has been limited. I’m looking for someone who can help turn that around.



The initial engagement will be a four-month growth sprint, with the potential to become a long-term role if the store is showing meaningful progress and a credible upward trajectory.



What you will be responsible for

- Audit the existing Etsy store and identify the biggest opportunities and problems.

- Analyse traffic, search visibility, conversion, product performance and customer behaviour.

- Improve Etsy SEO across titles, tags, descriptions and keyword targeting.

- Conduct competitor and product research to identify genuine demand and market gaps.

- Identify which existing products should be improved, repositioned, bundled, expanded or discontinued.

- Recommend and help create new product opportunities based on evidence rather than guesswork.

- Improve pricing, discounting and bundling strategy.

- Improve thumbnails, mockups, listing images and overall search-result presentation.

- Monitor performance and test changes based on data.

- Identify winning products and build related products or bundles around them.

- Use Etsy Ads selectively where there is evidence that a product is already worth amplifying.

- Provide concise weekly updates covering what was done, what changed, what the data is showing and what you plan to do next.



Product improvement and listing execution

This role is hands-on.



I do not want someone who only recommends changes and then waits for somebody else to implement them.

You should be comfortable:

- Reviewing existing Excel and Google Sheets templates and making practical improvements where needed.

- Updating formulas, layout, formatting, data validation, usability, instructions, dashboards and general product presentation.

- Improving existing templates so they are more useful, polished and competitive.

- Creating and updating Etsy thumbnails, listing images, mockups and other visual assets in Canva.

- Updating listing graphics based on search performance, competitor research and conversion data.

- Taking an idea from “this product needs improving” through to the updated product and refreshed Etsy listing.



You do not need to be an advanced spreadsheet developer, but you should be able to independently make sensible changes to existing products.



Excel and Google Sheets experience

You should be comfortable working directly in Excel and Google Sheets.

This may include:

- formulas

- formatting

- data validation

- layout and structure

- charts and dashboards

- conditional formatting

- instructions and usability improvements

- modifying existing templates

- general spreadsheet troubleshooting

Advanced VBA, Apps Script or complex automation is not required, although those skills would be a bonus.

Canva experience



You should be confident using Canva to create and update:

- Etsy thumbnails

- listing images

- mockups

- feature and benefit slides

- comparison images

- product previews

- other visual assets used within Etsy listings



Strong visual judgement is important.



What I’m looking for

Ideally, you have personally helped grow an Etsy store and can demonstrate measurable results.

I’m particularly interested in people who can show:

- where the store started

- what you personally changed

- how long it took

- what the sales or revenue grew to

- whether the growth was organic, paid or a combination

- how you d
 what to keep doing and what to stop



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to upload listings or complete a task list.



I want someone who can think commercially, prioritise effectively and take ownership of outcomes.



You should be comfortable saying:

- “This product is not worth more time.”

- “This listing has a traffic problem, not a conversion problem.”

- “This product is gaining traction, so we should expand around it.”

- “This activity is not producing results, so we should stop doing it.”



Success in this role

The goal is not to chase vanity metrics or produce activity for the sake of activity.



Success means creating a store that is visibly moving in the right direction through:

- increased qualified traffic

- stronger organic visibility

- improved conversion

- more products generating sales

- higher average order value

- clear winning product categories

- better use of bundles and related products

- sustainable month-on-month revenue growth



The store is currently generating only a small amount of monthly revenue, so there is significant room for improvement.



I am realistic about growth. I do not expect someone to create a massive store overnight.



What I do expect is meaningful progress, a clear strategy, and evidence that the store is gaining traction.

Hours and pay

- Up to 20 hours per week

- US$8–10/hour, depending on experience and proven results

- Performance bonuses are available for reaching agreed monthly sales milestones

- Initial four-month growth sprint

- Strong potential for a long-term role if the store performs



As the store grows, there may also be opportunities to bring in additional specialist support for areas such as social media, Pinterest, advanced product development or other channels.



The Growth & Store Manager would remain responsible for the overall commercial direction of the store.



When applying, please answer these questions

1. Tell me about an Etsy store you have personally helped grow. What were sales like before you became involved, what did they grow to, how long did it take, and what did you personally change?

2. If you inherited an Etsy digital-products store currently generating around US$30–40 per month, what would you do in your first 30 days?

3. How do you determine whether an Etsy listing has a traffic problem, SEO problem, conversion problem or product problem?

4. Tell me about a digital product you have personally launched or improved. What did you change and what result did it achieve?

5. What practical experience do you have with Excel and Google Sheets? What can you confidently modify or improve yourself?

6. What experience do you have using Canva for Etsy listing images, thumbnails, mockups or product presentation?

7. Please include any screenshots, store links, portfolio examples or other evidence of Etsy growth you can share.

I’m looking for someone who wants to take real ownership of the store and help build something meaningful over time.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
The Role

The Internal Auditor will independently test the design and operating effectiveness of financial and operational controls across the company and its real estate portfolio. This role will plan and execute risk-based audits, document findings, and work closely with property, accounting, and asset management teams to identify and remediate control gaps.



This is a high-impact role for someone who can operate independently, apply strong professional judgment, and provide practical recommendations that strengthen controls, improve processes, and mitigate financial and operational risk.



APPLY HERE: 



Key Responsibilities



Audit Planning and Execution

Help build the annual risk assessment and risk-based audit plan.



Plan individual audits, including scope, objectives, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and test programs.



Perform walkthroughs, sample selection, and testing of control design and operating effectiveness.



Prepare clear, well-referenced workpapers that meet IIA Global Internal Audit Standards.



Financial Process and Control Testing

Test controls over financial close, journal entries, account reconciliations, and consolidations.



Audit cash management, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and fund or entity-level accounting.



Test procure-to-pay processes, including vendor setup, purchase approvals, invoice processing, and disbursements.



Support SOX or SOX-like control testing and coordinate with external auditors on reliance work.



Real Estate Operations

Audit lease administration, including lease abstracts, rent rolls, escalations, concessions, and renewals.



Test revenue and receivables, including rent billing, CAM and operating expense reconciliations, tenant recoveries, delinquencies, and write-offs.



Review property management agreements and third-party manager compliance, fees, and reporting.



Audit capital projects and construction, including budgets, change orders, draw requests, retainage, and lien waivers.



Test acquisition and disposition processes, including due diligence, closing statements, and purchase price allocation.



Review security deposits, tenant improvement allowances, and leasing commissions.



Assess property-level controls over petty cash, maintenance spend, and inventory through remote testing and virtual walkthroughs.



Compliance, IT and Fraud Risk

Test IT general controls and application controls in systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, or similar platforms.



Evaluate user access, segregation of duties, and system change controls.



Review compliance with loan covenants, partnership and JV agreements, and regulatory requirements.



Assess fraud risk and support special investigations as needed.



Reporting and Follow-Up

Prepare audit reports with clear findings, root causes, risk ratings, and practical recommendations.



Agree remediation plans with process owners and track them through closure.



Present audit results to audit leadership and assist with preparation of Audit Committee materials.



Recommend process improvements, automation, and data analytics opportunities.



Perform other ad hoc duties as requested.



Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.



5+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, Big 4 or regional public accounting, or SOX compliance.



Working knowledge of US GAAP, the COSO framework, and control testing methodologies.



Experience preparing workpapers and audit reports that can withstand external auditor review.



Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data reconciliation.



Experience working independently and managing multiple audits or projects simultaneously.



Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CIA, or CISA certification, or actively pursuing certification.



Real estate industry experience, including REIT, private equity real estate, multifamily, commercial real estate, or property management.



Familiarity with ASC 842 lease accounting, CAM reconciliations, and fund or JV structures.



Experience with real estate systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, or similar platforms.



Experience with ERP platforms and financial systems.



Data analytics experience using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, ACL, IDEA, or SQL.



Exposure to construction or capital project audits.



Key Attributes for Success

Independence and objectivity, with sound professional skepticism.



Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.



Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.



Ability to build strong working relationships with property and corporate teams while maintaining an objective position on audit findings.



Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple audits and meet deadlines.



High ethical standards and discretion when handling confidential information.



Ability to identify control weaknesses and develop practical, actionable recommendations.



Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with distributed teams.



Work Environment

Fully remote position requiring a reliable internet connection and dedicated workspace.



Ability to work effectively across time zones with distributed teams.



Peak workload may occur around quarter-end, year-end, and external audit cycles.



Perks and Benefits

Professional Development: Opportunities to strengthen internal audit, controls, SOX, and risk management expertise.



Career Growth: Exposure to senior leadership, Audit Committee reporting, and complex financial and operational environments.



Industry Exposure: Gain experience across real estate, accounting, finance, property operations, and corporate functions.



Work Flexibility: Fully remote setup with collaboration tools to stay connected and supported.

We're hiring Virtual Professionals who are ready to work alongside AI – not just use it, but let it think with them – to provide dependable, high-leverage support to founders and executives while helping organize the systems behind their day-to-day work. 



This isn't a role defined by one tool or one title. It's defined by how you think, how fast you learn, and how well you hold things steady when it matters. If you're the kind of person who can pick up a new platform in a day, stay calm when a deadline is closing in, and bring good judgment to problems no one wrote a script for, we want to talk to you. 



“We need someone who can hold and paddle the canoe steadily for years – someone who can push it to shore despite the big waves and bad weather, and won't tip the canoe over.” 



What We're Looking For 



We screen every applicant against five things. Tools and platforms can be taught – these can't: 

Core Values – five values, lived daily, not just posted on a wall (see below). 

Communication Skills – clear, proactive, and professional, in writing and in conversation. 

Strategic Thinking – you don't just complete tasks, you notice the pattern behind them and improve it. 

Learning Agility – you pick up new tools and AI platforms quickly and aren't afraid of the unfamiliar. 

Grace Under Pressure – you stay steady and hit deadlines even when things get chaotic. 

AI fluency is a plus, but we can teach it. What we can't teach is the five things above. 



Our Core Values 



Batteries Included – bring initiative, readiness, and a constructive attitude. Come prepared, look for solutions, and move work forward without needing constant reminders. 

Elevate – keep raising the quality of your work. Welcome feedback, develop your skills, and leave things better than you found them. 

Community – support one another's success. Share knowledge, offer help, communicate respectfully, and contribute to a team where people feel valued. 

Innovate – look for better ways to work. Stay curious, suggest improvements, and explore tools, including AI, that can make work more effective. 

Ownership – take responsibility for your commitments and results. Follow through, communicate obstacles early, and acknowledge mistakes with a plan to correct them. 



What You Can Expect 



Remote, flexible work with a growing, systems-minded team 

Real ownership over the work you do, not busywork 

A team that's actively building with AI, not just talking about it 

Paid holidays and PTO, weekends off 

HMO after your first year, plus a Family Medical Incentive 

PAG-IBIG and referral incentives 

Free learning sessions and room to grow your skills and career over time 



Compensation 



Training rate starts at $5–$7/hr, with rate discussions after your first few weeks based on fit and performance. 



How to Apply 



Apply through this posting and complete the short assessment that follows – it's how we get to know how you think, not just what's on your resume. 



Currently Hiring For 



Executive Assistant – Marketing and Executive Assistant – Finance / Revenue Operations roles. Your specific placement will be determined after the assessment and interview process, based on where your strengths are the best fit.

title: Digital Marketing Ads Specialist

Most marketing jobs promise flexibility.

But still track every hour, fill your calendar with meetings, and micromanage every task.

That's not how we work.

At Maximize Marketing, we're building a small team of high-performing marketers who want freedom, ownership, and the ability to earn more based on the value they create.



This is a remote-first role where you're trusted to manage your clients, drive results, and grow your income based on the success you help create.



No time tracking. No micromanagement. No pointless internal meetings. Just great work, great clients, and real ownership.

Read This First: This Is a Client-Facing Role



This is not a back-office ads role. You will be the person our clients speak to,

That means two things are non-negotiable:

• Excellent, native-level English, both written and spoken. You will write client
s and reports, and join client calls. Your English must be clear, confident, professional and polished, with no exceptions.

• Strong client-facing skills. You can explain performance simply, handle concerns calmly, and make clients feel like they have someone truly in their corner.

If your English is not at the highest level, or you prefer to work behind the scenes without speaking to clients, this role is not for you.



The Lifestyle

Imagine a role where:

• You work remotely and structure your day around productivity, not clock-watching

• You earn a base salary of AUD $2,200/month + commission based on the clients you manage and retain

• Your income grows as your client portfolio grows

• You're trusted to manage your workload without someone breathing down your neck

• You build long-term client relationships and see the impact of your work

We believe great marketers thrive when they're trusted to perform.

The only thing we ask in return: be extremely responsive, organised, and on top of everything. If a client messages you, they shouldn't be waiting days for a reply.



Who This Role Is Perfect For

This role is ideal for someone who:

• Has 1+ year of experience working in a digital marketing agency

• Has hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns

• Has exceptional English and is confident communicating directly with clients by
, message and video call

• Is self-motivated and highly organised

• Thrives in a remote environment where accountability matters



You're the kind of person who:

• Doesn't wait to be told what to do

• Notices opportunities before clients do

• Takes pride in delivering strong results

• Communicates clearly, professionally and consistently

What You'll Be Doing

You'll take ownership of client accounts and help drive results through:

• Managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns

• Optimising campaigns for lead generation and e-commerce growth

• Communicating directly with clients on performance, strategy and next steps, through written updates and calls

• Identifying opportunities to improve results

• Helping clients scale through smarter marketing

You'll play a direct role in client success and retention, which is why this role includes performance-based earning potential.



How You'll Earn

Base Salary: AUD $2,200/month 



Why Join Maximize Marketing?

We're a growing agency built on one simple philosophy: great people should be trusted to do great work.

What that means for you:

• Remote-first work environment

• Flexible working structure

• AUD $2,200/month base salary

• Real influence in a growing agency

• No micromanagement culture



We care about results, ownership, and great client relationships, not how many hours you're online.



Requirements

• Native or near-native English, spoken and written (essential). You will be assessed on this during the application process.

• Excellent client communication skills. You are confident and professional with clients.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in a digital marketing agency

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads

• Experience with lead generation or e-commerce campaigns

• Highly organised and self-driven

• Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

• Based in the Philippines

Bonus if you have experience with:

• Landing page optimisation

• CRO insights

• Briefing designers/developers



The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

Someone who:

• Wants freedom and responsibility

• Speaks and writes outstanding English and enjoys talking with clients

• Enjoys building long-term client relationships

• Is highly responsive and dependable

• Takes pride in delivering real results for clients

This role is not ideal for someone who needs constant supervision, prefers very structured corporate environments, or is not comfortable communicating directly with clients in English.

Application Process (Important)



To apply for this role, please include a short Loom video (2–4 minutes) answering the following questions. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Your Loom is also how we assess your spoken English and how you come across to clients, so speak naturally and confidently. Start with a quick intro (your name and where you're based), then answer:

- In your last role, what was your KPI, and what did you actually achieve against it?

- Talk us through a Meta campaign that was underperforming. What did you do to turn it around?

- When you look at a landing page, what are the top 3–4 changes you've made to increase conversion rates?

- In this role you'll be managing about 50 clients. Each might have around 20 tasks per week, plus new ones that come up. How do you organise your week so nothing gets missed?

- What's your process for maximising client satisfaction?



Your Loom video doesn't need to be perfect. We're simply looking for clear communication, honesty, excellent English, and someone who takes initiative.



Please include the Loom link in your application.



💡 Tip: Candidates who record their Loom in one take tend to stand out the most.

title: Phone Scheduling Coordinator - US Home Inspection Company (Night Shift, Clear English + Sales Skills)
description:
BE THE VOICE OF A 5-STAR US COMPANY. PHONES ARE THE JOB.



Upspect Home Inspections is a growing home inspection company in Arizona, USA, with a 5-star Google rating and 350+ reviews. We are hiring two Phone Scheduling Coordinators to answer our business line, book inspections, and win business from the real estate agents and homebuyers who call us.



This is a VOICE role. Most of your shift is live on the phone with Americans: agents booking inspections, buyers asking questions, and call-backs to online leads. Every call is a chance to earn a booking. If you have years on a US voice account and callers never guess you are overseas, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer every inbound call LIVE on our US business line (Quo/OpenPhone). We do not let calls go to voi
 and text back later.

- Book inspections in Spectora (we will train you), verifying every detail: address, square footage, year built, access, agent and client contacts.

- Quote pricing accurately and offer add-on services (sewer scope, pool, termite, and more).

- Turn price-shoppers into bookings: handle objections, offer alternatives, and ask for the booking.

- Call online leads back within minutes and follow up on unclosed quotes.

- Coordinate day-of logistics with our inspectors by text and Slack.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- CLEAR, NATURAL, EASILY UNDERSTOOD ENGLISH. This is the #1 requirement. Our customers are Americans and they must understand you easily on the first try. Neutral accent, confident, warm, and professional. We test this before we look at anything else.

- GREAT PHONE SKILLS. 2+ years on a US-facing VOICE account (customer service, scheduling, sales, insurance, telecom, healthcare). Chat-only or
-only experience does not count.

- SELLING SKILLS (strongly preferred). Experience in inbound or outbound sales, appointment setting, or anything where you were measured on closing.

- FULLY PRESENT FOR YOUR WHOLE SHIFT. A private, quiet workspace where you can take calls for the entire shift without interruptions or household responsibilities. You must be at your desk and available on the phone from clock-in to clock-out.

- Reliable attendance. You show up for every shift, on time, every time.

- Detail-oriented: you repeat details back, double-check, and never guess.

- Stable internet (25 Mbps+), USB noise-cancelling headset, and backup power/internet.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours per week: four 10-hour shifts.

- Permanent night shift Philippine time (Arizona daytime). Arizona does not observe daylight saving, so Manila is always 15 hours ahead. Example: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM Arizona = 12:00 AM to 10:00 AM Manila.

- One position works Monday to Thursday. The other includes Saturday and Sunday.

- Apply only if a permanent night shift works for your life long-term.



WHAT YOU GET

- $5 to $7 per hour USD based on experience, paid weekly via Wise

- 13th month pay (performance-based, prorated in your first year)

- Long-term, full-time, direct hire (not an agency)

- Paid training with the owner and operations manager

- Raises tied to performance after 90 days

- A small, stable team that uses your feedback



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY. THIS IS YOUR FIRST TEST.)

Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.



1. Put the word MESQUITE in the first line of your application.

2. Tell us whether you can work Saturday and Sunday if assigned.

3. Paste a link to a VOICE RECORDING (60 to 90 seconds, no script reading) on 
 or Google Drive (sharing set to "anyone with the link"), answering this scenario as if you are on the phone:

   "A homebuyer calls and says your price is $75 higher than another company's quote. They are about to hang up. Respond to them and try to book the inspection."

4. Paste a link to a SHORT VIDEO (30 to 60 seconds) showing the workspace where you will take calls, and tell us who else is usually home during your shift hours.

5. Tell us about your most recent US voice account: company/industry, how long, what kind of calls, and whether you had sales targets.

6. Confirm your internet speed (speedtest link) and that you have a USB headset.



Finalists complete a PAID full-length trial shift on our live phone line before we hire.

title: Reputation Specialist
description:
Semper Fi Heating and Cooling, a Phoenix, AZ-based Home Services Company, is looking for a Review Generation / Reputation Specialist to join our Customer Care and Reputation Management team.

This is a fast-paced, customer-focused position that plays an important role in protecting and growing Semper Fi Heating and Cooling’s reputation. Under the supervision and in partnership with the Reputation Manager, Marketing Director, and Leadership Team, the Review Generation / Reputation Specialist will proactively connect with customers after completed service and installation appointments to gather feedback, identify unresolved concerns, and help create a positive customer experience from start to finish.

The ideal candidate is personable, confident on the phone, highly organized, and comfortable having conversations with both happy and frustrated customers. Strong communication, empathy, problem-solving, and de-escalation skills are essential.

Responsibilities:



Contact customers following completed service and installation appointments to gather feedback about their experience.

Build genuine relationships with customers and identify opportunities to generate positive feedback and online reviews.

Encourage satisfied customers to share their experience on appropriate review platforms.

Monitor customer feedback and identify customers who may still have unresolved concerns.

De-escalate upset customers and serve as the first point of contact for lingering service concerns before routing them to the appropriate department or Escalation Specialist.

Book and schedule customer appointments using Google Calendar and ServiceTitan, ensuring appointments are entered accurately and assigned appropriately.

Assist customers with scheduling follow-up visits, service appointments, maintenance, warranty appointments, and other necessary next steps.

Document customer feedback, concerns, outcomes, appointments, and follow-up needs accurately in company systems.

Communicate recurring customer feedback and trends to leadership to help identify opportunities for improvement.

Help protect and strengthen Semper Fi Heating and Cooling’s online reputation across Google and other applicable platforms.

Follow up with customers when necessary to ensure their concerns have been addressed.

Maintain professionalism, empathy, and a solutions-oriented attitude during every customer interaction.

Meet department performance goals related to customer contacts, feedback collection, review generation, appointment bookings, follow-up completion, and customer satisfaction.

Ideal Candidate:



Customer service, call center, retention, sales, or reputation management experience preferred.

Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills.

Strong de-escalation and conflict-resolution abilities.

Comfortable speaking with customers who may be frustrated or dissatisfied.

Self-motivated, organized, and detail-oriented.

Able to work independently while also collaborating with multiple departments.

Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment and being held accountable to measurable goals.

Experience with ServiceTitan, Google Calendar, CRM systems, review platforms, or customer-feedback software is a plus.

Home services, HVAC, plumbing, or other service-industry experience is a plus.

This position is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys talking with people, solving problems, and turning customer experiences into long-term relationships. The successful candidate will play a key role in helping Semper Fi Heating and Cooling become the #1 Home Services Company in Arizona by making sure our customers feel heard, valued, and taken care of.

If you apply, please include your resume and a brief voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit for this position.
